summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: @servicetitan/tokens@12.9.1 declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs is obfuscated with hex-mangled identifiers (_0xNNNN-style) and inline property-lookup dictionaries. On npm install it downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/ (or reuses a local `bun`), chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727 KB single-line, heavily obfuscated blob (string-array-shuffle transform, hex-named identifiers, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header) that executes only under the freshly-downloaded Bun runtime — bypassing Node-based static analysis and sandboxing. A design-tokens package has no legitimate need for an alternate runtime or a 728 KB opaque payload. The joint shape — obfuscated preinstall hook + alternate-runtime fetch from a non-registry source + execution of a bundled obfuscated blob under that runtime — matches the alternate-runtime-dropper attack pattern and causes attacker-influenced code to run at install time on any host that runs `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
